prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / ui-mockup.
Create a polished original Korean mobile events-page concept for CREFANS. Portrait 1024 x 1536 or taller as needed. This is a visual proposal, not a screenshot to reproduce verbatim.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 is only the layout/style reference: Korean delivery-app events list with wide rounded colorful cards, substantial friendly illustrations on the left, bold clean Korean headlines on the right. Image 2 is the content and CREFANS visual identity reference: preserve its FOUR approved rewards, the lavender star rosette, purple origami crown, TWO fresh green beans, lavender ribbon gift voucher, and purple/green brand personality. Do not carry over any fried chicken, discount amounts, percentage coupons, Baemin Club branding, October promotions or exclusive-offer claims from image 1.
DESIGN: A white page, small clean navy 'crefans' wordmark upper-left, a simple back arrow and '이벤트' page title. A compact campaign introduction '크레팬스 베타 1기' and '함께 만들어 주셔서 감사합니다'. Below it stack FOUR broad rounded rectangular benefit cards, equal width and consistent generous gaps, about 3:1 aspect ratio. Each card has its own soft vibrant background, approximately left 28% illustration and right 68% content. Use premium friendly soft-3D simplified illustrated objects similar to image2. Restrained gleam and soft shadows, no excessive small objects. Clean Korean sans-serif similar to Pretendard ExtraBold, no handwriting. All FOUR main benefit headlines must have THE SAME font size and weight; '프로모션 100콩' must NOT be oversized. Long second headline may use two lines. Keep first benefit headline one line where it fits, ample space and no clipping. The card backgrounds: 1 light violet with deeper violet accents, 2 pale periwinkle/cyan, 3 fresh mint/green, 4 pale warm rose/lavender. Text dark navy or deep purple with excellent contrast. No device frame, no iOS status/navigation bars, no app-bottom menu, no browser chrome.
EXACT TEXT, preserve all Korean content:
Header: '이벤트'
Intro title: '크레팬스 베타 1기'
Intro subtitle: '함께 만들어 주셔서 감사합니다'
CARD 1, lavender star badge on left:
Main title: '원년멤버 한정판 뱃지'
Small secondary notes at BOTTOM RIGHT of this card, right-aligned, muted, much smaller than headline:
'* 참여자 전원에게 드립니다.'
'* 프로필 페이지에 노출됩니다.'
'* 표시 여부는 직접 선택할 수 있습니다.'
CARD 2, purple crown plus a subtle promotion-ticket shape on left:
Main title in two lines: '주목할 크리에이터' then '광고상품 30일'
Secondary BOTTOM RIGHT:
'* 크리에이터 3명에게 드립니다.'
'* 주목할 크리에이터 광고상품 이용권을 제공합니다.'
CARD 3, exactly TWO rounded friendly green beans on left:
Main title: '프로모션 100콩'
Secondary BOTTOM RIGHT:
'* 팬 참여자 13명에게 지급합니다.'
CARD 4, lavender gift voucher with purple ribbon on left, no Baemin official logo needed:
Main title: '배민 1만원 상품권'
Secondary BOTTOM RIGHT:
'* 유용한 피드백을 주신 분 중'
'* 최대 3명에게 드립니다.'
Below cards, small muted RIGHT-ALIGNED footer:
'* 참여 기간과 혜택 지급 일정은 별도 안내합니다.'
Important: Every secondary explanatory line begins with literal '*'. No tiny ribbons containing eligibility counts at top-left; all target/count information is quiet in lower right. No extra rewards or invented policies, no fake buttons. All cards fully visible, no cut-off fifth card. Make it look like a real premium mobile event-list campaign, lively like the reference but distinctly CREFANS.
